introduction.title: Generate identifiers with an embedded timestamp
paragraphs: TSID creates identifiers whose leading portion represents their generation time. This gives IDs a chronological ordering and lets you recover a timestamp from the identifier later.

Use it for new rows when a timestamp-bearing ID is useful to your consumers. Keep an explicit event-time column when generation time and event time differ. If you need an exact insertion order across concurrent writers, record a separate sequence.
